name: Emissions & Regulatory Compliance
risk_rationale: New government emissions rules require massive investment in older engine technology just as the company needs that same budget to build electric vehicles. Every dollar spent on compliance is a dollar not spent on the EV transition.

name: New Electric Vehicle Launch
risk_rationale: Chinese competitors like BYD are selling EVs at prices Škoda cannot currently match. Slower-than-expected consumer demand for EVs in Europe makes it harder to recoup the high upfront development costs of two new models.

name: In-Car Software & Digital Experience
risk_rationale: The internal software platform failed and the company is now dependent on third-party partners for its in-car software. Tesla and competitors set a high bar for digital experience — falling behind risks losing customers who buy on technology, not just price.

name: Asia Market Expansion
risk_rationale: Withdrawing from China — once a major profit source — to redirect resources to India and Southeast Asia. Success depends on rapidly adapting the product and supply chain to very different markets, against well-established local competitors.

name: Vehicle Cybersecurity & Data Protection
risk_rationale: New international regulations require all new vehicles to pass mandatory cybersecurity standards or face a ban on sales. Retrofitting older vehicle electronics to meet these requirements is technically complex and expensive.
